plaatsen.tekst: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect
I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
